# UNDIP E-Journal System

> UNDIP's comprehensive open-access academic publishing platform hosting 140+ peer-reviewed scientific journals across multiple disciplines with international indexing.

The UNDIP E-Journal System is Diponegoro University's institutional repository and publishing platform for scholarly research. It provides access to peer-reviewed journals spanning engineering, law, marine sciences, renewable energy, agriculture, and other fields, with indexing in major databases including Scopus, Web of Science, DOAJ, and SINTA.
